name: Mariro
source:
A foreign exchange student who sleeps at the same inn as the main character.

She is a princess of a kingdom who earns quite a bit of money, although it is hard to say where.
Her reason for coming to Japan is to cure her blindness...

From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=6489]getchu[/url]]
